entities.name: Ritjit
entities.description: A guildless ogre of Ravnica once on an Azorius list of the ten most wanted criminals.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: Guild whose most-wanted list included Ritjit.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: Guild whose guild tree Ritjit attacked.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: Selesnya guild tree attacked by Ritjit.

entities.name: Wolf Riders
entities.description: Selesnya contingent that drove Ritjit out.

entities.name: Tin Street Market
entities.description: Market where Ritjit destroyed 81% of the stalls.

entities.name: Selesnya Saproling Nursery
entities.description: Where Ritjit was last seen eating young saprolings.

events.summary: Ritjit attacked Vitu-Ghazi, breaching the outer defenses, and was driven out by Wolf Riders.
events.quote: He was driven out by a contingent of Wolf Riders

events.summary: Ritjit continued his rampage at Tin Street Market, destroying 81% of the stalls, until distracted by a vegetable cart and detained.
events.quote: he destroyed 81% of the stalls in less than twenty minutes

events.summary: After three years in a cell Ritjit smashed the door and was last seen eating saprolings at the Selesnya nursery.
events.quote: He was last seen in the vicinity of the Selesnya Saproling Nursery
